content:
maria_cs: Heads-up team — SageWell sent a follow-on security ask. They want a 1-page summary + sanitized evidence bundle for embeddings (pseudonymization approach, retention, key management) by next Wed. Sam from SageWell copied in.

sam_sagewell: Quick note: our vendor board needs a plain-English line on how you avoid storing PII in embeddings. Also curious if BYOK is possible on hosted.

ben_sec: Short answers we can provide: 1) We do not index raw PII by default; recommend pre-processing to remove PHI/PII or replace with deterministic hashes. 2) Default embeddings retention is 90d, configurable per contract. 3) BYOK available on Dedicated/Private. Hosted supports customer-managed KMS with limited lifecycle controls.

olivia_legal: Also need subprocessors list and a SOC2 scope excerpt showing processing + hosting for embeddings. I'll prepare a minimal legal blurb.

maria_cs: @tom_ops can you pull a sanitized sample flow and upload to the evidence bucket? Please replace any user identifiers with deterministic salts/hashes and redact email addresses.

tom_ops: On it. Will scrub staging logs and produce a short dataflow diagram. ETA Tue EOD.

jira-bot: Created ticket CS-4589: "SageWell vendor evidence for embeddings" assigned to tom_ops, due 2026-04-13.

ben_sec: I'll attach a tiny control mapping to the ticket: Encryption -> AES-256/KMS, Transport -> TLS1.2+, Logging -> token-level audit logs retained 90d.

maria_cs: Plan: tom uploads bundle -> olivia + ben finalize blurb -> I send to Sam. Thanks all :thumbsup:
